nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus schedli Browne, 1963, VSN_3330, Scolytinae: Trypophloeini. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes that this taxon may be a synonym of a previously described Hypothenemus; the stable VSN is retained while the uncertainty is recorded.
